When activated, it follows a selected access method: You can set a Timer if you want to have Strict Mode active only for a certain time. If Follow schedules is selected, it will start blocking only once the selected schedules have also been turned on, and it is also possible to select a combination of the access methods.

Block device settings restricts your access to phone settings where you could bypass any AppBlock blockings (by, for example, removing the app’s permissions).
